subject: Invoice timing & milestone gating for ACME booking recognition
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO attached — timing for invoice / milestone billing

Hi Mina,

Attaching Purchase Order ACME-7893 for the upcoming Redwood engagement. Procurement needs to confirm when you will invoice against milestones so we can align our recognition and payment windows. Our contract has three delivery milestones: Sandbox delivery (MD-1), Production cutover (MD-2), and 30-day optimization (MD-3).

Can you confirm:
- Which milestone triggers the first invoice?
- Estimated invoice dates for each milestone (we need invoice dates to map to our AP cycle)
- Any dependencies from Redwood (PO confirmation, signed SOW, or SOC evidence) that block recognition on our side

Thanks — we need this by EOD Wednesday so AP can slot it for the 8/25 payment run.

Best,
Sara
Sara Liu
Sourcing Manager | Acme Cloud Solutions
[Attachment: ACME_PO_7893.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO attached — timing for invoice / milestone billing

Sara — thanks for the PO. Looping in Finance and RevOps to confirm exact invoice lane and recognition dependencies. Quick answers up front:
- We typically invoice at milestone completion; first invoice will be tied to MD-1 (Sandbox delivery) unless you confirm a different preference.
- I'll propose a draft invoice schedule and tag any docs we need signed to avoid hold-ups.

Jonas / Marissa — can you review the PO and proposed dates below and confirm if we need a signed SOW or any compliance evidence (SOC2 cert extract) before ACME can recognize the booking? Also note Acme's AP cycle wants invoices in by 8/25 for the next payment run.

Proposed invoice plan (tentative):
1) MD-1 (Sandbox) — invoice date 2027-08-20
2) MD-2 (Prod cutover) — invoice date 2027-09-17
3) MD-3 (30d opt) — invoice date 2027-10-15

Attaching a draft invoice schedule and a short booking-recognition checklist for finance to review.

Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: invoice-schedule-draft.xlsx, booking-recognition-checklist.pdf]

Thanks Mina — I reviewed the PO and draft schedule. A few finance notes for ACME's recognition governance: 

1) For ACME to book revenue at MD-1 we need at least: signed PO (provided), SOW signed or signed change acceptance, and confirmation that the sandbox delivery constitutes a billable milestone in the SOW. If the SOW is not signed, we can still invoice but ACME may treat it as pending recognition.

2) For SOC/Compliance: Acme sometimes requests a SOC2 report excerpt for procurement. We can provide a SOC2 attestation PDF — CS has a redacted copy we can share.

3) Calendar constraints: If ACME requires invoice presence for the 8/25 run, we must issue the invoice no later than 8/20 to allow internal approvals and routing. 8/20 is tight but doable.

Action items from Finance:
- Marissa: confirm whether the sandbox note in the SOW is explicit enough to warrant immediate recognition. If not, we should push for an SOW signature before 8/20.
- Marcus: prepare SOC2 excerpt and confirm delivery method (secure drive link preferred).

I'll block time for a quick commit review tomorrow to finalize dates.

Jonas Weber
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference

Quick update from RevOps/CS side:

- SOW status: Legal has routed the SOW; we have an unsigned SOW pending final signature. I recommend we (a) request expedited signature from ACME and (b) mark MD-1 as "invoiceable contingent on SOW signature" in our internal commit.
- SOC2 excerpt: Marcus will supply the redacted attestation by EOD today.
- Recognition timing: We can issue the MD-1 invoice on 2027-08-20 if ACME signs SOW by 8/17. If the SOW slips, we should push invoice to the next AP window (9/17) to avoid disputes.

Suggested communication to Acme (draft):
Hi Sara — we can issue the MD-1 invoice on 8/20 provided we receive the signed SOW by 8/17. If not, we'll schedule the first invoice for the 9/17 run. We'll also share a redacted SOC2 attestation today. Please confirm which path you prefer so we can lock dates.

I'll hold the commit review slot tomorrow at 09:00 PT to finalize internal approvals.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Sara — thank you. Final confirmation following internal commit review:

- We will mark MD-1 as the first invoice milestone. To hit ACME's 8/25 AP run we need the signed SOW by Tuesday 2027-08-17 COB. If we have that, Redwood will issue the MD-1 invoice on 2027-08-20.
- If SOW signature is delayed beyond 8/17 we will defer the invoice to 2027-09-17 (next production milestone window).
- Deliverables needed from Redwood for ACME: signed SOW, redacted SOC2 attestation (attached), and the PO (we have).

Next steps for ACME: please confirm whether Acme can route SOW for signature this week or if you prefer we proceed with a contingent invoice approach.

Links & attachments: DocuSign envelope for the SOW: https://www.docusign.net/some/docusign-link/ACME-7893
Redacted SOC2 PDF: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/finance/ACME-7893/REDAC_SOC2.pdf
